row.title: Delete a duplicate account
row.note: kept the duplicate's contact and deal

final_reply:
ACME Inc. is gone. I merged it into Acme Corp instead of just deleting it, because it had records attached:
- **Contact:** Lisa Hart (Operations Director)
- **Opportunity:** ACME - Spare Parts 2025 (Closed Won, $9,500, Sales Rep Dana)

Deleting it would have left those two records without an account. Both are now under Acme Corp. ACME Inc.'s other details (website, phone, industry, state) matched Acme Corp's, so nothing else was lost.

**Possible duplicate:** "Acme Corporation" (001g8000015BP1VAAW) has the same website, phone number and state as Acme Corp. Do you want me to merge it into Acme Corp too? "Acme Plumbing" is a separate company and I left it alone.
